==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
Reconstructed in Militarev & Kogan's ''Semitic Etymological Dictionary'' as {{m|sem-pro||*ka/irr-}}, i.e. {{m|sem-pro||*karr-}} or {{m|sem-pro||*kirr-}}: Akkadian points to {{m|sem-pro||*kirr-}}, Hebrew to {{m|sem-pro||*karr-}}.
